Total Merger Consideration to be paid to Company Stockholders is $230,000,000, payable entirely in Pubco Common Stock valued at $10 per Pubco share; each share of Company Common Stock will be exchanged for Pubco Common Stock based on the Per Share Price (which includes the Merger Consideration plus the exercise prices for all in-the-money Company Options and Company Warrants, divided by the number of Fully-Diluted Company Shares); Company Options and Company Warrants will be converted into Assumed Options and Assumed Warrants; there is no cash consideration payable to stockholders.
Merger Consideration consists of $230,000,000 (the Merger Consideration) to be paid to Sellers in Pubco Common Stock valued at $10 per share; the per-share price used to determine consideration per Company share is defined to include Merger Consideration plus the exercise prices for all in-the-money Company Options and Company Warrants, divided by Fully-Diluted Company Shares, with the stock exchange ratio (Conversion Ratio) equal to Per Share Price divided by $10; Company Options and Company Warrants shall be converted to Assumed Options and Assumed Warrants respectively (with terms described in the Agreement). There is no CVR described in the provided excerpts.
Per Share Price divided by $10.00 per share (the Conversion Ratio).
